input: Make my grandmother's akara shop go viral by Friday. I have six photos. I won't post every day.

response.answer:
THE HUMAN CLAUSE: Akara shop virality
Fictional reverse CAPTCHA. Choose three priorities; the other six wait. Fixed terms still apply. There is no universal right answer.

TERMS: Won't post every day.

|---|---|---|
| 4. I will write a catchy caption | 5. I will research trending sounds | 6. I will create a "behind-the-scenes" story |
| 7. I will ask for customer testimonials | 8. I will invent a secret ingredient | 9. I will offer a limited-time discount |

THE TENSION: Identifying a viral hook (2) requires understanding what makes content shareable, while researching trending sounds (5) focuses on platform-specific tactics. Prioritizing one might mean missing out on the other's potential reach.

YOUR MOVE: Reply with three numbers and this card. I'll turn your choices into a concrete agreement an agent could work from. You can also rewrite a box.
